nodes.label: Go CI: ci-ok gate job
nodes.rationale: Single required check per repo ruleset; needs: list is the only edit when adding jobs. always() is required, otherwise a failed dependency makes this job skipped and skipped counts as passing.

nodes.label: ops-github-runner-build-and-deploy.yml
nodes.rationale: Plain workflow, not workflow_call: builds and deploys the self-hosted runner image every org workflow depends on. Deploy job hand-rolls the homelab bump instead of calling the homelab-deploy composite action.

nodes.label: Release: tag vX.Y.Z and move floating vN tag
nodes.norm_label: release: tag vx.y.z and move floating vn tag

nodes.label: Public visibility of this repo (reusable workflow access)
nodes.norm_label: public visibility of this repo (reusable workflow access)
nodes.rationale: Repo must be public because most calling app repos are public; GitHub blocks public callers from private reusable workflows. Nothing sensitive lives here: secrets are fetched at runtime.

nodes.label: Floating major tag versioning (callers pin @v1)
nodes.rationale: Callers pin a floating major tag so fixes reach them without edits; a major bump creates a new floating tag so breaking changes never reach callers that have not opted in. Immutable vX.Y.Z tags allow exact pinning.

nodes.label: cd-build-deploy-semver.yml (reusable workflow)
nodes.rationale: Deploy gating under environment: production cannot be set by the caller (uses: jobs cannot set environment), so two deploy variants live here, selected by use_production_environment; one app's Infisical OIDC sub claim breaks under an environment.

nodes.label: github-runner ops: update homelab job (environment production)
nodes.norm_label: github-runner ops: update homelab job (environment production)
nodes.rationale: Hand-rolled git clone/sed/commit of homelab values.yaml instead of the homelab-deploy composite; README says build-and-deploy keeps its own job after relocation.

nodes.rationale: Chosen over Gitleaks: same author, feature work moved to Betterleaks, and gitleaks-action needs a paid org license key.
